SlideMate 0.7 shows you things: the tutor draws diagrams, builds hands-on demos and quizzes you on each slide.

### New
- **Diagrams and interactive demos.** The tutor can draw a diagram or build a small demo you can play with right in the chat.
- **Quiz me.** Test yourself on the slide you're on with its flashcards, and the ratings count towards your reviews.
- **Suggested questions.** Grey suggestions in the ask box give you a good next question; press Tab to use one.
- **Cards follow your revision.** New flashcards from slides you just revised come first when you study.
- **Missed a lecture?** SlideMate fills in its notes from your university's lecture recording.
